what: Senior Center in the Community Center: bingo, trivia, fitness classes, a free Wednesday hangout, day trips and monthly lunches, plus van rides, home chore help and loans of medical equipment.

service_name: Pearl Wright Senior Center, Royal Oak Township
location_name: Pearl Wright Senior Center, Royal Oak Township
what: Senior center with bingo, bowling, health talks, crafts, movie days, day trips, a Focus: HOPE food program and bus rides (Fannie Adams Transportation).

service_name: Macomb County Office of Senior Services
location_name: Macomb County Office of Senior Services
what: The county's office for people 60 and older and their caregivers: senior lunches, Meals on Wheels, a friendly caller, help with benefits, a loan closet for medical equipment, and adult day care.
eligibility: People 60 and older who live in Macomb County, and their caregivers. Enter the building at door C.

location_name: Senior center, Clinton Township
what: The Senior Adult Life Center: activities, classes, a fitness center and ride information for adults 55 and older. Membership has a fee.
eligibility: Adults 55 and older, with proof of age and where you live. Residents pay $75 once; others pay $75 a year. Closed when Chippewa Valley schools close for weather.

location_name: Senior center, Shelby Township
what: Activities, fitness, rides, and a free loan closet for medical equipment, for adults 50 and older. The senior bus goes to medical visits nearby for 50 cents each way.
eligibility: Adults 50 and older. Yearly membership: $5 for Shelby Township and Utica residents, $10 for others.

service_name: Senior center for Roseville and Eastpointe
location_name: Senior center for Roseville and Eastpointe
what: Activities, exercise classes, trips, games, a computer room, blood pressure checks, and senior lunches, for adults 50 and older.
eligibility: Adults 50 and older who live in Roseville or Eastpointe.
source_name: Recreation Authority of Roseville & Eastpointe website

location_name: Senior center, Chesterfield Township
what: A place for adults 55 and older to meet people, take classes, join activities and find help.
eligibility: Adults 55 and older.

location_name: Tucker Senior Center, Harrison Township
what: Activities, exercise classes, trips, rides (Dial-A-Ride) and Meals on Wheels for adults 55 and older.
eligibility: Adults 55 and older. Closed on township holidays, and when L'Anse Creuse schools close for bad weather.

location_name: Senior center, Sterling Heights
what: Activities, fitness, a walking track, trips, and lunch Monday to Friday at 11:30am for adults 50 and older. Many programs are free. Lunch is a $3 suggested donation for people 60 and older.
eligibility: Anyone 50 and older. You do not have to live in Sterling Heights.

service_name: Senior Activity Center, St. Clair Shores
location_name: Senior Activity Center, St. Clair Shores
what: Activities, classes, a fitness center, blood pressure checks, and lunch Monday to Friday at 11:30am (sign up a week ahead) for adults 50 and older.
eligibility: Adults 50 and older. Yearly membership: $25 for residents, $40 for others. Lunch does not need a membership.
source_name: City of St. Clair Shores website

what: Lunch every weekday at 11:30am (call the day before), Meals on Wheels, a fitness room, a computer lab, classes, trips, help with Medicare and Medicaid, and a lawyer who visits once a month, for adults 50 and older.

location_name: Ford Senior Activity Center, Taylor
what: Activities, classes, a fitness room, a computer room with free internet, lunch Monday to Thursday, rides to the center and to stores, and a free loan closet for medical equipment for Taylor residents. Rides to Taylor doctors cost $2.
eligibility: Anyone 50 and older. There is no fee to join. For lunch, call before 10:30am at least a day ahead.

location_name: Copeland Senior Center, Wyandotte
what: Social days, card games, bingo, trips, and lunch Monday to Thursday at 11:15am ($3 suggested donation). Weekday bus and van rides in Wyandotte and Southgate cost $1.50 each way.
eligibility: Older adults. Rides are for Wyandotte seniors 55 and older and people with disabilities; call 734-324-4522 a day ahead. For lunch, call 734-324-7279 a day ahead.

location_name: Senior center, Garden City
what: The senior center at the Radcliff Center: games, bingo, fitness classes, trips, and help with food: Focus: HOPE boxes for people 60 and older and monthly USDA food.
eligibility: Most activities are for adults 50 and older. Food help has income limits.

location_name: Senior center, Romulus
what: Daily hot lunch at the center, Meals on Wheels, free rides to medical and personal visits, weekly shopping trips, free blood pressure checks, free visits with a foot doctor and lawyers each month, Medicare help, a loan closet for medical equipment, and activities.
eligibility: Older adults. Call to ask who can join.

location_name: Senior programs, Redford Township
what: Trips, classes, exercise, card games, blood pressure checks, tax help, Medicare and Medicaid help, Meals on Wheels, and hot lunch at the Redford Community Center. The Redford Connector bus gives rides Mon-Fri 8am-3pm for $2.
eligibility: Older adults. The senior club is for Redford residents 55 and older ($15 a year). The loan closet is for Redford residents only. For lunch, call 313-387-2778 by 11am the day before.

location_name: Senior Resource Center, Inkster
what: Exercise classes, a walking club, a Friendship Club on Thursdays, crafts, and a men's group, at the Senior Resource Center in the Dozier Recreation Center. Rides are available.
eligibility: Older adults in Inkster. Check in at the Resource Center. Closed on city holidays.

location_name: Senior services, Allen Park
what: Activities and services all year, and rides to the doctor, bank, store and other places. Rides cost $2 each way plus a $9 yearly fee.
eligibility: Allen Park residents 62 and older. The office is inside the Allen Park Community Center.

location_name: Senior activities, Riverview
what: A senior club (cards, dominoes), bingo, senior walking, computer classes, free monthly health talks with a light lunch, exercise classes and trips, in the Senior Activity Rooms at City Hall.
eligibility: Older adults. The club costs $12 a year. You do not have to live in Riverview.

location_name: Senior center, Ecorse
what: Services and activities for older adults, Meals on Wheels for people who cannot leave home, bus service, and a monthly pickup of free commodity food.
eligibility: Older adults. You can stop in or call.

eligibility: Older adults. Free food is for people 60 and older.

location_name: Eton Senior Recreation Center, Dearborn Heights
